title: Antigravity plugin manifest
description: Manifest for an Antigravity plugin (plugin.json at the plugin root, or in .antigravity-plugin/). Keys are case-sensitive. Antigravity ignores keys it doesn't recognize, and `agy plugin validate` reports them. A recognized key with the wrong type stops the plugin from loading. Documentation: https://antigravity.google/docs/plugins

$schema.description: URL of this schema, for editor autocomplete and validation.

name.description: Machine name of the plugin: letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores. `agy plugin install` requires it. A plugin loaded from a folder without a name is named after the folder.

displayName.description: Name shown in the plugin list instead of name.

display_name.description: Alias of displayName. displayName wins when both are set.

description.description: Short description shown in the plugin list.

version.description: Version shown with the plugin. Any string is accepted.

disabled.description: Whether the plugin starts disabled. Enabling or disabling the plugin yourself takes precedence.

logo.description: Plugin icon: a relative path to a .png, .svg, .jpg, .jpeg, or .webp file inside the plugin, or an https URL on google.com, gstatic.com, or googleusercontent.com. Other values are ignored.

suggestedPrompts.description: Up to three example prompts for the plugin.

suggested_prompts.description: Alias of suggestedPrompts, used only when suggestedPrompts is empty.

skills.description: Extra skill folders, relative to the plugin root, loaded in addition to skills/. Takes one path or a list of paths.

source.description: Set by older plugin imports. Don't set it yourself.

sourcePath.description: Set by older plugin imports. Don't set it yourself.
